issue.title: Accept the '=' glyph in ACE keymap overrides
issue.description: Proposed by epic phase sase-j9.1 while adding the sibling '-' glyph alias. Reproduction at master c0238421b: .venv/bin/python confirms sase.ace.tui.keymaps.key_validation.is_valid_key('=') is False even though isolate_panels is bound to '=' by default and Textual names the glyph equals_sign. A user override written as isolate_panels: '=' is therefore rejected and reverted. Scope: add '=': 'equals_sign' to _KEY_ALIASES in src/sase/ace/tui/keymaps/key_validation.py, add focused validation/canonicalization coverage, and verify keymap loading accepts the raw glyph. This is a pre-existing latent gap, not caused by sase-j9.
